body.title: fix: API pagination in `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{index}/reviews`
body.body:
Fixes a bug in pagination in the API `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{index}/reviews`: if a review is found in the database in state pending, it would be omitted from the return value after the pagination is applied, resulting in pagination returning an unexpected number of records.

This issue was identified by code analysis on possible API issues that will arise from enforcing pagination in the API (#13960).

body.title: fix: API pagination in `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/timeline`
body.body:
Fixes two bugs in pagination in the API `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/timeline`:
- Cross-reference comments from other issues and pull requests were filtered for visibility to the remote repository *after* the pagination, resulting in pagination returning an unexpected number of records
- The `X-Total-Count` header was set to the number of records being returned in the page, not the number of records present in the API query.

These issues were identified by code analysis on possible API issues that will arise from enforcing pagination in the API (#13960).

The new implementation performs fewer queries for repositories.  Following the reimplementation of the filtering logic for the API, a refactor to use the same method was implemented for the UI to take advantage of the performance change and align the implementations.

body.title: WIP: feat: add a non-claiming ListAvailableJobs runner RPC
body.body:
> **Blocked — opened for visibility.** This cannot merge until [forgejo/actions-proto#35](https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/actions-proto/pulls/35) is merged and tagged `v0.9.0`; it's up now so the server change can be understood alongside the protocol change that motivates it. Until then `go.mod` carries a temporary `replace` pointing at the actions-proto PR branch so CI can build; the final version will drop the `replace` and pin `code.forgejo.org/forgejo/actions-proto v0.9.0`. Independent of (not stacked on) #15343.

## What's here

Implements `RunnerService.ListAvailableJobs` (actions-proto #35): a runner, authenticated with its own credentials, lists the jobs it could run — scoped to its registration (repo / org / global) — without claiming them, minting tokens, or touching secrets.

Returns scheduling metadata only. For a global runner, `repo_id`/`owner_id`/`name` are included per job only when that job's repo is readable anonymously (public + Actions enabled); the scheduling fields (`id`/`run_id`/`attempt`/`handle`/`runs_on`) are always returned. Repo- and org-scoped runners are already bounded by the scope query.

Peeking doesn't mark the runner online: `withRunner` skips the `last_online` update for `ListAvailableJobs` unless the request sets `update_online: true`, so a standby scaler polling with runner credentials doesn't surface as an idle-online runner.

## Why a runner RPC and not the HTTP endpoint

`/actions/runners/jobs` needs a user/org/admin token. A runner — or a runner-side autoscaler holding only `x-runner-uuid`/`x-runner-token` — has none. This lets it inspect its own queue with least privilege, in-band on the connection it already has, then claim a specific job through the existing `FetchSingleTask(handle)`. It deliberately returns no secrets so a compromised idle runner can't harvest them for jobs it never runs. Companion REST filters for API-token consumers are in #15343.

## Release notes - Security bug fixes - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14811): 2026-10-12 security patches - Breaking security features - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14148): Move internal communication to UNIX socket. The `INTERNAL_TOKEN` can now be dropped from the configuration, and the UNIX socket path can be configured using the `INTERNAL_LISTENER_PATH` options. This change removes the `./forgejo generate secret INTERNAL_TOKEN` command and updates the contrib Forgejo systemd unit file. The `forgejo.service` example systemd file has been updated to set `RuntimeDirectory=forgejo`, which is a recommended setting for all systemd users.
See the [documentation](https://forgejo.org/docs/latest/admin/config-cheat-sheet/#server-server) for more information. - Breaking bug fixes - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13960): make pagination mandatory on all APIs. The `page` and `limit` parameters to some Forgejo APIs have previously been optional, and if not provided have been interpreted as "retrieve all data". Forgejo will now default `page` to `1`, and default `limit` to `[api].DEFAULT_PAGING_NUM` (default: 30) on these APIs. For the affected list of APIs, please review https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13960. - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/15047): server-side `if` evaluation should use typed interpretation of workflow inputs, allowing booleans to be interpreted correctly rather than as strings. As a breaking change caused by this fix, Forgejo Actions workflows that use `workflow_dispatch` with boolean inputs will now receive boolean values in `forgejo.event.inputs.`, rather than string inputs. - ## Release notes - Security bug fixes - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14811): 2026-10-12 security patches - Breaking security features - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14148): Move internal communication to UNIX socket. The `INTERNAL_TOKEN` can now be dropped from the configuration, and the UNIX socket path can be configured using the `INTERNAL_LISTENER_PATH` options. This change removes the `./forgejo generate secret INTERNAL_TOKEN` command and updates the contrib Forgejo systemd unit file. The `forgejo.service` example systemd file has been updated to set `RuntimeDirectory=forgejo`, which is a recommended setting for all systemd users.
See the [documentation](https://forgejo.org/docs/latest/admin/config-cheat-sheet/#server-server) for more information. - Breaking bug fixes - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13960): make pagination mandatory on all APIs. The `page` and `limit` parameters to some Forgejo APIs have previously been optional, and if not provided have been interpreted as "retrieve all data". Forgejo will now default `page` to `1`, and default `limit` to `[api].DEFAULT_PAGING_NUM` (default: 30) on these APIs. For the affected list of APIs, please review https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13960. - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/15047): server-side `if` evaluation should use typed interpretation of workflow inputs, allowing booleans to be interpreted correctly rather than as strings.
